verdict.rationale: Swell supports bulk product import/export via CSV (swell-docs-14) and bulk stock tracking (swell-docs-15, swell-docs-28), which are bulk-style operations, but there is no evidence of an AI-native bulk API (e.g., batch create/update/delete endpoints) or agent-driven bulk automation across arbitrary item sets. Missing for 10: documented bulk REST/GraphQL endpoints, agent-callable batch operations, and evidence of scale/performance guarantees for bulk actions.
